dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate 2D geometric narrowing initiated at the mid-section and transitioning to a sharp linear taper at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical bulge on the right side of the mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median intensity consistent with slate-grey; significant absence of mature white pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency distribution of diffuse, low-contrast lighter grey patches across the central and posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Soft, diffuse gradient transitions between the primary slate-grey canvas and lighter textural patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge forming a sharp geometric line from the mid-dorsal area to the peduncle.
